~~~python
"""Memristive material network · Qualification adjudication computation for the declared model (pure Python, exact rationals, deterministic)
Declared model 𝔐_R (algorithmic level, discrete beats, model mode):
  Crossbar array of n_in rows × n_out columns; device conductance G_ij ∈ [lo, hi] (Structural Position), baseline b; column nodes are integrate-and-fire comparator circuits.
  Each beat: (1) row read pulses s_i ∈ {0,1} (determined by the letter), teaching current I_j injected into the column (out-of-boundary); (2) column capacitor integration v~_j = λ·v_j + Σ_i G_ij·s_i + I_j (reads the pre-beat G);
  (3) firing g_j = [v~_j ≥ θ]; (4) reset v_j := 0 if g_j, otherwise v~_j;
  (5) device voltage V_ij = V_pre·s_i + bp·V_post·g_j (bp: column back-propagation pulse switch, declared by the protocol);
  (6) threshold-type state equation: ΔG_ij = α·[V_ij ≥ V_set] − β·[V_ij ≤ −V_rst] − ρ·(G_ij − b) (ρ: volatile relaxation; reads the pre-beat G); clipped to [lo, hi].
Declared parameter family: V_pre = V_post = 1/2, V_set = 1, V_rst = 1 (pulses nonnegative, reset branch not triggered), lo = 0, hi = 2.
The 𝒟₁ single-beat setting takes the LOC valid domain [b, hi] (1/4 grid); on the formation side the PLUS component is certified by PS (after same-beat removal PLUS is 0 and no firing is added), and the net increment is reported separately;
direct writes are actual between-beat state transitions (writes), and the actual and diagnostic branches both read the post-write state; the family conditions are written out for both values of bp.
Computation: 1. 𝒦_g membership (beat-by-beat comparison with a general form implemented independently from Definition 2; whatever lies beyond the family is reported as outside the scope of application);
     2. rule-level P10 (MechC of shiyin_full, mechanism routes declared exhaustive / undeclared);
     3. component-wise proof on the actual window of the main instance (TraceSet, Part, HDyn on the same T; 𝒟₁ single-beat setting; same-beat removal M1₀) and the Fld verdict;
     4. negative examples and boundaries (no formation; nonvolatile read-only window; volatile read-only window).
"""
import sys, os, json, runpy, tempfile, contextlib, io, itertools, random
from fractions import Fraction as Fr
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); ARGV = list(sys.argv)
R = {}
def S(x): return str(x)

# ======================= Declared model (physical form) =======================
class Prm:
    def __init__(s, n_in=2, n_out=1, lam=Fr(1, 2), th=Fr(1), alpha=Fr(1, 4), beta=Fr(1, 4), rho=Fr(1, 8), b=Fr(1, 4),
                 lo=Fr(0), hi=Fr(2), Vpre=Fr(1, 2), Vpost=Fr(1, 2), Vset=Fr(1), Vrst=Fr(1)):
        s.n_in, s.n_out, s.lam, s.th, s.alpha, s.beta, s.rho, s.b, s.lo, s.hi = n_in, n_out, Fr(lam), Fr(th), Fr(alpha), Fr(beta), Fr(rho), Fr(b), Fr(lo), Fr(hi)
        s.Vpre, s.Vpost, s.Vset, s.Vrst = Fr(Vpre), Fr(Vpost), Fr(Vset), Fr(Vrst)
    def d(s): return {k: S(v) for k, v in vars(s).items()}
PAT = {'A': (1, 0), 'B': (0, 1), 'AB': (1, 1), 'none': (0, 0)}
X2 = [(0, 0), (1, 0)]                                                # Structural Positions for n_in = 2, n_out = 1

def init(p): return {'G': {(i, j): p.b for i in range(p.n_in) for j in range(p.n_out)}, 'v': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out}
def phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=1, setG=None, drop=None):
    """One beat. setG: 𝒟₁ single-beat setting (rewrites the conductance read before the beat); drop: same-beat removal ('letter' removes the input letter, 'I' removes the teaching current). Returns (new state, in-beat record)."""
    G = dict(st['G']); v = list(st['v'])
    if setG: G.update(setG)
    s = PAT['none' if drop == 'letter' else letter]; I = [Fr(0)] * p.n_out if drop == 'I' else [Fr(x) for x in I]
    vt = [p.lam * v[j] + sum(G[(i, j)] * s[i] for i in range(p.n_in)) + I[j] for j in range(p.n_out)]
    g = [1 if vt[j] >= p.th else 0 for j in range(p.n_out)]
    v2 = [Fr(0) if g[j] else vt[j] for j in range(p.n_out)]
    G2, contrib, parts = {}, {}, {}
    for (i, j), w in G.items():
        V = p.Vpre * s[i] + bp * p.Vpost * g[j]
        pot = p.alpha if V >= p.Vset else Fr(0); dep = -p.beta if V <= -p.Vrst else Fr(0); rel = -p.rho * (w - p.b)
        Sx = w + pot + dep + rel; G2[(i, j)] = min(p.hi, max(p.lo, Sx))
        contrib[(i, j)] = G2[(i, j)] - w; parts[(i, j)] = {'pot': pot, 'dep': dep, 'rel': rel, 'clamp': Sx != G2[(i, j)]}
    return {'G': G2, 'v': v2}, {'s': s, 'I': I, 'vt': vt, 'g': g, 'c': contrib, 'parts': parts, 'G_read': G}

# ======================= 1. 𝒦_g membership =======================
def kg_step(q, o, s, I):
    """Independent implementation of Definition 2 of The Adjudication Form of Field Concretization for Candidate Hosts (literal order). q: member parameters; o = (w, v, x, y)."""
    w, v, x, y = o; n_in, n_out = q['n_in'], q['n_out']
    vt = [q['lam'][j] * v[j] + sum(w[(i, j)] * s[i] for i in range(n_in)) + I[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    g = [1 if vt[j] >= q['th'][j] else 0 for j in range(n_out)]
    v2 = [q['vr'][j] if g[j] else vt[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    x2 = [q['dx'][i] * x[i] + s[i] for i in range(n_in)]; y2 = [q['dy'][j] * y[j] + g[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    pl, bap = q['plastic'], q['bap']; w2 = {}
    for (i, j), wij in w.items():
        Pp = q['Ap'] * x2[i] if (pl and bap and g[j]) else Fr(0)
        Pm = -q['Am'] * y2[j] if (pl and bap and s[i]) else Fr(0)
        Pr = -q['rho'] * (wij - q['b'][(i, j)]) if pl else Fr(0)
        w2[(i, j)] = min(q['hi'][(i, j)], max(q['lo'][(i, j)], wij + Pp + Pm + Pr))
    return (w2, v2, x2, y2), g
def as_kg(p, bp=1):
    """Declared physical parameters → 𝒦_g member parameters (map: d_x = d_y = 0, A₊ = α, A₋ = 0, ρ unchanged, θ, λ unchanged, v_reset = 0, plastic = 1, bap = bp).
    Conditions under which the map holds (family conditions): V_pre < V_set, bp·V_post < V_set, V_pre + bp·V_post ≥ V_set (potentiation only on co-occurrence); pulses nonnegative (reset branch not triggered)."""
    X = [(i, j) for i in range(p.n_in) for j in range(p.n_out)]
    return {'n_in': p.n_in, 'n_out': p.n_out, 'lam': [p.lam] * p.n_out, 'th': [p.th] * p.n_out, 'vr': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out,
            'dx': [Fr(0)] * p.n_in, 'dy': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out, 'Ap': p.alpha, 'Am': Fr(0), 'rho': p.rho, 'plastic': True, 'bap': bool(bp),
            'b': {k: p.b for k in X}, 'lo': {k: p.lo for k in X}, 'hi': {k: p.hi for k in X}}
def fam_cond(p, bp=1):
    """Family conditions: V_pre < V_set, V_post < V_set; when bp = 1, V_pre + V_post ≥ V_set (co-occurrence reaches threshold); when bp = 0 the potentiation component is identically zero."""
    return p.Vpre < p.Vset and p.Vpost < p.Vset and (bp == 0 or p.Vpre + p.Vpost >= p.Vset)
def compare(p, hist, bp=1):
    q = as_kg(p, bp); st = init(p); o = (dict(st['G']), list(st['v']), [Fr(0)] * p.n_in, [Fr(0)] * p.n_out); bad = clamp = eq = 0
    for letter, I in hist:
        st, rec = phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=bp); o, g = kg_step(q, o, PAT[letter], [Fr(x) for x in I])
        if st['G'] != o[0] or st['v'] != o[1] or rec['g'] != g: bad += 1
        clamp += sum(1 for k in rec['parts'] if rec['parts'][k]['clamp']); eq += sum(1 for j in range(p.n_out) if rec['vt'][j] == p.th)
    return bad, clamp, eq
rng = random.Random(20261111); n_beats = n_bad = n_clamp = n_eq = n_hist = 0
FAM = dict(lam=[Fr(0), Fr(1, 2), Fr(3, 4)], th=[Fr(1), Fr(3, 2)], alpha=[Fr(1, 8), Fr(1, 4), Fr(3, 8)], rho=[Fr(0), Fr(1, 16), Fr(1, 8)], b=[Fr(1, 4), Fr(1, 2)])
for _ in range(400):
    kw = {k: rng.choice(v) for k, v in FAM.items()}; n_out = rng.choice([1, 2]); p = Prm(n_out=n_out, **kw); bp = rng.choice([0, 1])
    L = rng.randint(4, 16); hist = [(rng.choice(list(PAT)), [rng.choice([0, Fr(1, 2), 1]) for _ in range(n_out)]) for _ in range(L)]
    bad, cl, eq = compare(p, hist, bp); n_hist += 1; n_beats += L; n_bad += bad; n_clamp += cl; n_eq += eq
R['1 𝒦_g membership (random histories within the declared family, physical form vs independent implementation of Definition 2; G, v and firing compared beat by beat, x′, y′ are the mapped eligibility traces)'] = {'histories': n_hist, 'beats': n_beats, 'mismatched beats': n_bad, 'clipping occurrences': n_clamp, 'integration exactly at threshold': n_eq}
# beyond the family: V_pre ≥ V_set (input alone potentiates; potentiation is no longer conditioned on firing)
p_out = Prm(Vpre=Fr(1)); hist = [('A', [0]), ('A', [0]), ('none', [0])]
R['1′ Beyond the declared family (V_pre = 1 ≥ V_set)'] = {'family conditions': fam_cond(p_out), 'beat-by-beat mismatches with Definition 2 (same map)': compare(p_out, hist)[0],
    'verdict': 'not covered by the adjudication path (not in 𝒦_g: the potentiation component bypasses the firing condition; not read as 0)'}

# ======================= 2. Rule-level P10 =======================
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
    cwd = os.getcwd(); os.chdir(tmp); sys.argv = ['full', os.path.join(tmp, 'o.json')]
    X = runpy.run_path(os.path.join(HERE, 'shiyin_full.py')); os.chdir(cwd); sys.argv = ARGV
Mx, RunX, E, MechC, versions_of, vanc_at, version_path = (X[k] for k in ('Mx', 'RunX', 'E', 'MechC', 'versions_of', 'vanc_at', 'version_path'))
P0 = Prm()
GD = ('pred', lambda x: P0.lo <= x <= P0.hi, [Fr(j, 32) for j in range(0, 65)])
NUM = ('pred', lambda x: True, [Fr(j, 8) for j in range(-8, 33)])
B01 = ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1)})
ROUTES = {'integ', 'fire', 'dev', 'port:In'}
def mx(decl=True):
    lay = {'G00': 'theta', 'G10': 'theta', 'v': 'r', 'vt': 'r', 'g': 'r', 's0': 'r', 's1': 'r', 'I': 'r'}
    dom = {'G00': GD, 'G10': GD, 'v': NUM, 'vt': NUM, 'g': B01, 's0': B01, 's1': B01, 'I': ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1, 2), Fr(1)})}
    FM = {'integ': ('Run', {'vt'}), 'fire': ('Run', {'g', 'v'}), 'dev': ('Sed', {'G00', 'G10'})}
    M = Mx(lay, dom, (lambda s: s['G00'] + s['G10'], {'G00': 1, 'G10': 1}), ports={'In': {'s0', 's1', 'I'}}, FM=FM, fid='𝔐_R')
    if decl: M.mech_routes = set(ROUTES); M.mech_exhaustive = True
    return M
def st0(): return {'G00': P0.b, 'G10': P0.b, 'v': Fr(0), 'vt': Fr(0), 'g': Fr(0), 's0': Fr(0), 's1': Fr(0), 'I': Fr(0)}
def dev_fn(i, p=P0):
    def f(v):
        w = v[f'G{i}0']; V = p.Vpre * v[f's{i}'] + p.Vpost * v['g']
        Sx = w + (p.alpha if V >= p.Vset else 0) - (p.beta if V <= -p.Vrst else 0) - p.rho * (w - p.b)
        return {f'G{i}0': min(p.hi, max(p.lo, Sx))}
    return f
def steps_for(k, letter, I):
    s = PAT[letter]
    return [((k, 1), E(f'in{k}', 'In', 'port', 'env', [], ['s0', 's1', 'I'], lambda v, s=s, I=I: {'s0': Fr(s[0]), 's1': Fr(s[1]), 'I': Fr(I)})),
            ((k, 2), E(f'integ{k}', 'Run', 'integ', 'F', ['v', 'G00', 'G10', 's0', 's1', 'I'], ['vt'],
                       lambda v: {'vt': P0.lam * v['v'] + v['G00'] * v['s0'] + v['G10'] * v['s1'] + v['I']}, {'G00': 1, 'G10': 1, 'v': 1, 's0': 1, 's1': 1, 'I': 1})),
            ((k, 3), E(f'fire{k}', 'Run', 'fire', 'F', ['vt'], ['g', 'v'], lambda v: {'g': Fr(1), 'v': Fr(0)} if v['vt'] >= P0.th else {'g': Fr(0), 'v': v['vt']})),
            ((k, 4), E(f'dev0_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G00', 's0', 'g'], ['G00'], dev_fn(0))),
            ((k, 5), E(f'dev1_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G10', 's1', 'g'], ['G10'], dev_fn(1)))]
TEACH = sum((steps_for(k, 'A', 1) for k in range(1, 5)), [])
R['2 Rule-level P10 (teaching protocol: (A + teaching current 1) × 4 replayed; declared routes exhaustive)'] = MechC(lambda: RunX(mx(), st0()), {'teaching protocol': TEACH})
R['2′ Mechanism undeclared'] = MechC(lambda: RunX(mx(False), st0()), {'teaching protocol': TEACH})

# ======================= 3. Main instance: component-wise proof on the actual window =======================
FORM = [('A', [1])] * 4
WIN = [('A', [0]), ('A', [0]), ('none', [0])] * 2
def run(p, hist, bp_of=lambda k: 1, writes=None):
    """writes: {beat index k: {position: value}}: direct writes by the actor, taken as the actual between-beat state transition before beat k; tr[k] is the post-write state, and both the actual and the diagnostic branches read it."""
    writes = writes or {}; st = init(p); tr = [st]; recs = []
    for k, (letter, I) in enumerate(hist):
        if k in writes: st = {'G': {**st['G'], **writes[k]}, 'v': list(st['v'])}; tr[k] = st
        st, rec = phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=bp_of(k)); tr.append(st); recs.append(rec)
    return tr, recs
def subsets(X): return [list(c) for n in range(1, len(X) + 1) for c in itertools.combinations(X, n)]
def LOC(p): return [Fr(j, 4) for j in range(0, 9) if p.b <= Fr(j, 4) <= p.hi]   # 𝒟₁ single-beat setting: 1/4 grid points on the LOC valid domain [b, hi]
def judge(p, hist, w0, bp_of=lambda k: 1, writes=None):
    """The beats of hist with index ≥ w0 form window W. For each T, judge TraceSet (q, r), Part and HDyn; Fld = ∃T with all three true."""
    tr, recs = run(p, hist, bp_of, writes); W = range(w0, len(hist)); X = sorted(tr[0]['G'])
    res = {}
    for T in subsets(X):
        key = '{' + ', '.join(f'G{i}{j}' for i, j in T) + '}'
        q = all(tr[k + 1]['G'][x] != p.b for k in W for x in T) and all(tr[w0]['G'][x] != p.b for x in T)
        r_w = []
        for k in range(0, w0):                                   # PS certification of the formative history: actual PLUS ≠ 0; after same-beat removal of a field-entry component, PLUS = 0 and no firing is added (M1₀); net increment reported separately
            for x in T:
                if recs[k]['parts'][x]['pot'] == 0: continue
                for drop in ('letter', 'I'):
                    _, alt = phys_step(p, tr[k], *hist[k], bp=bp_of(k), drop=drop)
                    if alt['parts'][x]['pot'] == 0 and all(a_ <= b_ for a_, b_ in zip(alt['g'], recs[k]['g'])):
                        r_w.append({'beat': k, 'position': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]}', 'removal': f'remove {drop}', 'PLUS actual/removed': (S(recs[k]['parts'][x]['pot']), S(alt['parts'][x]['pot'])),
                                    'net increment actual/removed': (S(recs[k]['c'][x]), S(alt['c'][x])), 'firing after removal': alt['g']}); break
        part_w, hdyn_w, hself = None, None, None
        for k in W:
            for x in T:
                for val in LOC(p):
                    if val == tr[k]['G'][x]: continue
                    _, alt = phys_step(p, tr[k], *hist[k], bp=bp_of(k), setG={x: val})
                    if part_w is None and recs[k]['s'][x[0]] and (alt['vt'] != recs[k]['vt'] or alt['g'] != recs[k]['g']):
                        part_w = {'beat': k, 'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}', 'integration actual/set': (S(recs[k]['vt'][0]), S(alt['vt'][0])), 'firing actual/set': (recs[k]['g'], alt['g'])}
                    if hdyn_w is None:
                        for y in T:
                            if recs[k]['c'][y] == 0: continue
                            via = 'pot' if alt['parts'][y]['pot'] != recs[k]['parts'][y]['pot'] else ('rel' if alt['parts'][y]['rel'] != recs[k]['parts'][y]['rel'] else None)
                            if via == 'rel' and x == y and hself is None:
                                hself = {'beat': k, 'affected position': f'G{y[0]}{y[1]}', 'actual component c': S(recs[k]['c'][y]), 'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}'}
                            if via and (x != y or via == 'pot'):
                                hdyn_w = {'beat': k, 'affected position': f'G{y[0]}{y[1]}', 'actual component c': S(recs[k]['c'][y]), 'component breakdown': {kk: S(vv) for kk, vv in recs[k]['parts'][y].items()},
                                          'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}', 'component breakdown under setting': {kk: S(vv) for kk, vv in alt['parts'][y].items()},
                                          'route': 'in-boundary: G → integration → firing → device voltage → ΔG' if via == 'pot' else 'device self-relaxation (reads own-position G)'}
                                break
        ts = q and bool(r_w)
        res[key] = {'TraceSet': ts, 'q (retention nonzero within W)': q, 'r witness (PS: PLUS component; net increment reported separately)': r_w[:3], 'Part': part_w is not None, 'Part witness': part_w,
                    'HDyn': hdyn_w is not None, 'HDyn witness': hdyn_w, 'all three true': ts and part_w is not None and hdyn_w is not None,
                    'action via self-relaxation only (reading undetermined, not counted in HDyn)': hself if hdyn_w is None else None}
    fld = any(v['all three true'] for v in res.values())
    selfonly = (not fld) and any(v['TraceSet'] and v['Part'] and v['action via self-relaxation only (reading undetermined, not counted in HDyn)'] for v in res.values())
    G_end = lambda k, x: recs[k]['G_read'][x] + recs[k]['c'][x]               # end-of-beat value (excluding any subsequent between-beat direct write)
    traj = [(k, hist[k][0], S(hist[k][1][0]), recs[k]['g'][0], S(G_end(k, (0, 0))), S(G_end(k, (1, 0)))) for k in range(len(hist))]
    return {'trajectory (beat, letter, teaching current, firing, G00, G10)': traj, 'between-beat direct writes (before → after)': {k: {f'G{x[0]}{x[1]}': (S(G_end(k - 1, x)), S(v)) for x, v in w_.items()} for k, w_ in (writes or {}).items()}, 'per T': res, 'Fld': 1 if fld else ('⊥' if selfonly else 0)}
J = judge(P0, FORM + WIN, len(FORM))
J['verdict'] = '1 (model mode; declared protocol and certified witness)' if J['Fld'] else '0 requires the 𝔅₀ antecedent'
R['3 Main instance (volatile ρ = 1/8; formation (A + 1) × 4; W = (A, A, rest) × 2)'] = J

# ======================= 4. Negative examples and boundaries =======================
B0 = '𝔅₀ antecedent: 𝒟₁ declared, mechanism list declared exhaustive, record faithful (model mode [structural]); the negative determination rests on the analytic argument, and the finite grid computation is only a consistency check'
J1 = judge(P0, [('A', [0])] * 4 + WIN, 4)
J1['verdict'] = ('1' if J1['Fld'] else '0 (' + B0 + ')'); J1['analytic'] = 'Without teaching current, v < θ holds throughout under wA = b, so there is never any firing and PLUS is identically zero; at G = b relaxation is zero: no structural position deviates from baseline over the whole run, T_max = ∅, and TraceSet fails for every T'
R['4.1 No formation (no teaching current)'] = J1
P_nv = Prm(rho=Fr(0))
J2 = judge(P_nv, FORM + WIN, len(FORM), bp_of=lambda k: 1 if k < len(FORM) else 0)
J2['verdict'] = ('1' if J2['Fld'] else '0 (' + B0 + ')'); J2['analytic'] = 'Within W, bp = 0: device voltage ≤ V_pre = 1/2 < V_set, PLUS identically zero; ρ = 0: relaxation zero; reset branch not triggered: no structural position has an effective event within W, and HDyn fails for every T'
R['4.2 Nonvolatile (ρ = 0) read-only window (back-propagating pulse off within W, device voltage ≤ 1/2 < V_set)'] = J2
J3 = judge(P0, FORM + WIN, len(FORM), bp_of=lambda k: 1 if k < len(FORM) else 0)
J3['verdict'] = {1: '1', 0: '0 (' + B0 + ')', '⊥': '⊥ (within W the only action on T is device self-relaxation: whether relaxation that reads the own-position Trace-Response bears the trace-issued action of HDyn is a reading this computation does not fix; not read as 0)'}[J3['Fld']]
R['4.3 Volatile (ρ = 1/8) read-only window'] = J3

R['5 Real material'] = {'verdict': '⊥', 'reasons': ['The model verdict judges only the declared model 𝔐_R (algorithmic level); read-back for a material host requires counterparts of implementation fidelity and model faithfulness (The Adjudication Form of Field Concretization for Candidate Hosts, 5.5), which are not given',
                    'The Adjudication Form of Material Field Concretization has registered that the premise of memristive nanowire networks, “the reset network is identical to the original network,” is yet to be verified; this computation gives no material observation']}

def fix(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict): return {str(k): fix(v) for k, v in o.items()}
    if isinstance(o, (list, tuple)): return [fix(x) for x in o]
    if isinstance(o, Fr): return str(o)
    return o
json.dump(fix(R), open(os.path.join(HERE, 'memr_checks.json'), 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str)
~~~

~~~python
"""The Possibility Form of Field Induction in Memristive Material Networks · computation (pure Python, exact rationals, deterministic)
Reuses the declared model 𝔐_R and the qualification adjudication of memr_checks (prefix-executed up to just before “4. Negative examples and boundaries”; LOC valid domain, PLUS certification by PS, direct writes as between-beat state transitions).
Permitted class: input ports (row-pulse letters, column teaching current); direct-write port Rw (the actor's programming pulse writes a device conductance directly to a declared value, landing on the Structural Position G_ij). B, the field rules and the levels are unchanged.
Qualification and act lie in the same history.
Computation:
  1. Forward construction of C^R: goal setting g (goal conductance) → direct write G00 := g → the field's own running and sedimentation within the window; reading Φ := G00 (host drive of the A pathway).
     Item by item: Org₀, Rewrite, Eff, Bear, Bear_R,W (bearing starts from the direct write), GoalCond (the goal determines the direct write through the value-write chain), ΔΦ_W ≠ 0, entry-drive comparison; Fld of the actual window re-adjudicated after the direct write.
  2. Control: the same actor pushes G00 to the same magnitude through the input ports only (letter + teaching current): Rewrite = 0, reported as input and sedimentation, not counted as host adjustment.
  3. Negation of C^G: exhaustive check of the variable table and port table of 𝔐_R: no dynamic-level gate variables, no gating port; each quantity read by transmission is assigned to its level; under the permitted class Gate is always 0.
  Boundary case: (b) rest beat before the window, no goal event; further boundary cases and controls are listed.
"""
import os, sys, json, contextlib, io, runpy, tempfile, itertools
from fractions import Fraction as Fr
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
def prefix(script, stop):
    p = os.path.join(HERE, script); src = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read().split(stop)[0]; sc = {'__file__': p}
    cwd = os.getcwd()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): exec(compile(src, p, 'exec'), sc)
    os.chdir(cwd); return sc
M = prefix('memr_checks.py', '# ======================= 4. Negative examples and boundaries')
Prm, phys_step, PAT, P0, FORM, WIN = (M[k] for k in ('Prm', 'phys_step', 'PAT', 'P0', 'FORM', 'WIN'))
Mx, RunX, E, Org0, Rewrite, Gate, BearW, GoalCond, in_W, version_path, versions_of, Eff, Bear = (M['X'][k] for k in ('Mx', 'RunX', 'E', 'Org0', 'Rewrite', 'Gate', 'BearW', 'GoalCond', 'in_W', 'version_path', 'versions_of', 'Eff', 'Bear'))
S = str; R = {}
GD, NUM, B01 = M['GD'], M['NUM'], M['B01']

# ======================= Model (direct-write port and goal declaration added; field rules as in 𝔐_R) =======================
def mx():
    lay = {'G00': 'theta', 'G10': 'theta', 'v': 'r', 'vt': 'r', 'g': 'r', 's0': 'r', 's1': 'r', 'I': 'r', 'gol': 'ext'}
    dom = {'G00': GD, 'G10': GD, 'v': NUM, 'vt': NUM, 'g': B01, 's0': B01, 's1': B01, 'I': ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1)}), 'gol': ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1, 4), Fr(1), Fr(5, 4)})}
    FM = {'integ': ('Run', {'vt'}), 'fire': ('Run', {'g', 'v'}), 'dev': ('Sed', {'G00', 'G10'}), 'ext_goal': ('Run', {'gol'})}
    m = Mx(lay, dom, (lambda s: s['G00'], {'G00': 1}), ports={'In': {'s0', 's1', 'I'}, 'Rw': {'G00', 'G10'}}, FM=FM, fid='𝔐_R',
           goal={'role': 'Xg', 'var': 'gol', 'field': '𝔐_R'}, target={'gol': {'field': '𝔐_R', 'rel': 'device conductance'}})
    m.mech_routes = {'integ', 'fire', 'dev', 'ext_goal', 'port:In', 'port:Rw'}; m.mech_exhaustive = True
    return m
def st0(): return {'G00': P0.b, 'G10': P0.b, 'v': Fr(0), 'vt': Fr(0), 'g': Fr(0), 's0': Fr(0), 's1': Fr(0), 'I': Fr(0), 'gol': Fr(0)}
p = P0
def dev(i):
    def f(v):
        w = v[f'G{i}0']; V = p.Vpre * v[f's{i}'] + p.Vpost * v['g']
        Sx = w + (p.alpha if V >= p.Vset else 0) - (p.beta if V <= -p.Vrst else 0) - p.rho * (w - p.b)
        return {f'G{i}0': min(p.hi, max(p.lo, Sx))}
    return f
def beat(r, k, letter, I, part_in='env'):
    s = PAT[letter]
    r.ev((k, 2), E(f'in{k}', 'In', 'port', part_in, [], ['s0', 's1', 'I'], lambda v, s=s, I=I: {'s0': Fr(s[0]), 's1': Fr(s[1]), 'I': Fr(I)}))
    r.ev((k, 3), E(f'integ{k}', 'Run', 'integ', 'F', ['v', 'G00', 'G10', 's0', 's1', 'I'], ['vt'],
                   lambda v: {'vt': p.lam * v['v'] + v['G00'] * v['s0'] + v['G10'] * v['s1'] + v['I']}, {'G00': 1, 'G10': 1, 'v': 1, 's0': 1, 's1': 1, 'I': 1}))
    r.ev((k, 4), E(f'fire{k}', 'Run', 'fire', 'F', ['vt'], ['g', 'v'], lambda v: {'g': Fr(1), 'v': Fr(0)} if v['vt'] >= p.th else {'g': Fr(0), 'v': v['vt']}))
    r.ev((k, 5), E(f'dev0_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G00', 's0', 'g'], ['G00'], dev(0)))
    r.ev((k, 6), E(f'dev1_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G10', 's1', 'g'], ['G10'], dev(1)))
def forms(r, W):
    s_in = r.trace[0][1]; s_end = r.trace[-1][1]
    return {'Org₀': Org0(r), 'Rewrite(P)': Rewrite(r, 'P'), 'Gate(P)': Gate(r, 'P'), 'Bear_R,W(P)': BearW(r, 'P', {'Rw'}, W),
            'Bear_W(P, all act kinds)': BearW(r, 'P', {'Rw', 'In', 'Gt'}, W),
            'GoalCond(P; Rw × θ; W)': GoalCond(r, 'P', kinds={'Rw'}, layers=('theta',), W=W), 'ΔΦ_W': S(r.M.phi(s_end) - r.M.phi(s_in)),
            'Φ entry, Φ end': (S(r.M.phi(s_in)), S(r.M.phi(s_end)))}
TARGET = Fr(5, 4)
# 1 Forward C^R
r1 = RunX(mx(), st0())
r1.ev((1, 0), E('G1', 'Run', 'ext_goal', 'Xg', [], ['gol'], lambda v: {'gol': TARGET}))
r1.ev((1, 1), E('rw1', 'Rw', 'port', 'P', ['gol'], ['G00'], lambda v: {'G00': v['gol']}))
for k, (L_, I) in enumerate([('A', 0), ('A', 0), ('none', 0), ('A', 0)], 1): beat(r1, k, L_, I[0] if isinstance(I, list) else I)
W1 = ((1, 0), (4, 9))
rw = next(e for e in r1.events if e['id'] == 'rw1'); gv = next(k for k in versions_of(r1, rw) if k[0] == 'G00')
dv = [e for e in r1.events if e['src'] == 'dev' and 'G00' in e['changed']]
R['1 Forward C^R (goal conductance 5/4; direct write G00; within the window A, A, rest, A)'] = {**forms(r1, W1),
    'direct-write version': '|'.join(map(str, gv)), 'sedimentation within the window (G00)': [(e['id'], e['out']) for e in dv],
    'first-beat integration reads the direct-write version': next(e for e in r1.events if e['id'] == 'integ1')['read_versions']['G00'] == gv,
    'version path direct write → first-beat sedimentation': version_path(r1, gv, next(k for k in versions_of(r1, dv[0]) if k[0] == 'G00')) if dv else None,
    'firing per beat': [e['out']['g'] for e in r1.events if e['src'] == 'fire']}
# 1′ Fld of the actual window re-adjudicated after the direct write (physical form; the write is applied after the formative part, before a rest beat; window = the W that follows)
judge = M['judge']
JW = judge(P0, FORM + [('none', [0])] + WIN, len(FORM) + 1, writes={len(FORM): {(0, 0): Fr(7, 4)}})
R['1′ Boundary case (b): formative part → direct write G00 := 7/4 before the rest beat (rest beat before the window; physical form, no goal event) → W'] = {'Fld': JW['Fld'], '{G00} three items': {k: JW['per T']['{G00}'][k] for k in ('TraceSet', 'Part', 'HDyn')},
    'HDyn route': (JW['per T']['{G00}']['HDyn witness'] or {}).get('route')}
# 2 Control: input ports only
r2 = RunX(mx(), st0())
r2.ev((1, 0), E('G1', 'Run', 'ext_goal', 'Xg', [], ['gol'], lambda v: {'gol': TARGET}))
for k in range(1, 5): beat(r2, k, 'A', 1, part_in='P')
W2 = ((1, 0), (4, 9))
R['2 Control: the actor acts through the input ports only (A + teaching current) × 4'] = {**forms(r2, W2), 'final G00': S(r2.s['G00']),
    'actor event kinds': sorted({e['kind'] for e in r2.events if e['part'] == 'P'}), 'classification': 'input (actor events only at the In port) and sedimentation (dev written by the device state equation); not counted as host adjustment'}
# 3 Negation of C^G: exhaustive check of variables, ports and transmission reads
m = mx()
trans_reads = ['v', 'G00', 'G10', 's0', 's1', 'I']
R['3 C^G: exhaustive check of the gating objects of 𝔐_R'] = {
    'layer table': {v: L for v, L in sorted(m.layer.items())}, 'm-level (dynamic permeability) variables': [v for v, L in m.layer.items() if L == 'm'],
    'port table': {k: sorted(v) for k, v in m.ports.items()}, 'gating port Gt': 'Gt' in m.ports,
    'quantities read by transmission (integration) and their levels': {v: m.layer[v] for v in trans_reads},
    'permeability quantity of connection ij': 'G_ij (θ level, Sedimentation-Degree); the read-out passes connection by connection only through G_ij·s_i, with no per-connection dynamic factor',
    'Gate(P) under the permitted class': {'1': Gate(r1, 'P'), '2': Gate(r2, 'P')},
    'classification of teaching current I': 'applied at the column node and processed by the integration rule of the node itself—input; it is on no connection and does not constitute connection patency'}

# ======================= 4. Same history: formative prefix → goal setting and direct write 5/4 → A, A, rest, A =======================
H4 = FORM + [('A', [0]), ('A', [0]), ('none', [0]), ('A', [0])]; WK = len(FORM)
# 4.1 Physical form: qualification adjudication (window = the four beats after the direct write; the direct write is applied before beat 5, is a permitted Rw, and does not enter the signal removal of the r witness)
J4 = judge(P0, H4, WK, writes={WK: {(0, 0): TARGET}})
t0 = J4['per T']['{G00}']
R['4.1 Field-Concretization Qualification in the same history (physical form, model adjudication program)'] = {'Fld': J4['Fld'], 'trajectory (beat, letter, teaching current, firing, G00, G10)': J4['trajectory (beat, letter, teaching current, firing, G00, G10)'], 'between-beat direct writes': J4['between-beat direct writes (before → after)'],
    '{G00}': {k: t0[k] for k in ('TraceSet', 'q (retention nonzero within W)', 'r witness (PS: PLUS component; net increment reported separately)', 'Part', 'Part witness', 'HDyn', 'HDyn witness')},
    'all r-witness beats precede the direct write (formative prefix)': all(w['beat'] < WK for w in t0['r witness (PS: PLUS component; net increment reported separately)'])}
# 4.2 Event form: full event replay of the same history and Field Induction item by item
r4 = RunX(mx(), st0())
for k in range(1, WK + 1): beat(r4, k, 'A', 1)
k = WK + 1
r4.ev((k, 0), E(f'G{k}', 'Run', 'ext_goal', 'Xg', [], ['gol'], lambda v: {'gol': TARGET}))
r4.ev((k, 1), E(f'rw{k}', 'Rw', 'port', 'P', ['gol'], ['G00'], lambda v: {'G00': v['gol']}))
for j, L_ in enumerate(['A', 'A', 'none', 'A']): beat(r4, k + j, L_, 0)
W4 = ((k, 0), (k + 3, 9))
n_in = next(i for i, e in enumerate(r4.events) if e['id'] == f'G{k}')
s_in, s_end = r4.trace[n_in][1], r4.trace[-1][1]
rw4 = next(e for e in r4.events if e['id'] == f'rw{k}'); gv4 = next(x for x in versions_of(r4, rw4) if x[0] == 'G00')
dv4 = [e for e in r4.events if e['src'] == 'dev' and 'G00' in e['changed'] and e['phase'] > rw4['phase']]
ins = {e['id'] for e in r4.events if e['kind'] == 'In'}
anc_entry = r4.vtrace[n_in]['G00']
entry_ver = max((x for x in anc_entry if isinstance(x, tuple) and x[0] == 'G00' and isinstance(x[1], int) and anc_entry[x] is True), key=lambda x: x[1])
R['4.2 Field Induction item by item in the same history (event replay)'] = {
    'window-entry Φ (G00)': S(r4.M.phi(s_in)), 'window-end Φ': S(r4.M.phi(s_end)), 'ΔΦ_W': S(r4.M.phi(s_end) - r4.M.phi(s_in)),
    'bearing organization of the entry tendency': {'bearing component': 'syn G00 (conductance of device 00)', 'entry version': S(entry_ver),
                          'entry version written by sedimentation, source contains input events': any(isinstance(x, tuple) and len(x) == 3 and x[2] in ins and anc_entry[x] is True for x in anc_entry)},
    'Org₀ (auxiliary)': Org0(r4, (k, 0)), 'Eff(P)': Eff(r4, 'P'), 'Bear(P)': Bear(r4, 'P'),
    'drive under A at the first window beat (pre-write state / actual)': (S(M['P0'].lam * 0 + s_in['G00']), S(next(e for e in r4.events if e['id'] == f'integ{k}')['out']['vt'])), 'Rewrite(P)': Rewrite(r4, 'P'), 'Gate(P)': Gate(r4, 'P'), 'Bear_R,W(P)': BearW(r4, 'P', {'Rw'}, W4),
    'GoalCond(P; Rw × θ; W)': GoalCond(r4, 'P', kinds={'Rw'}, layers=('theta',), W=W4),
    'target pointing (GoalRep/Target)': (r4.M.goal['field'], r4.M.target['gol']['field'], r4.M.fid),
    'direct-write version': '|'.join(map(str, gv4)),
    'version path direct write → first-beat sedimentation': version_path(r4, gv4, next(x for x in versions_of(r4, dv4[0]) if x[0] == 'G00')),
    'event identities listed separately (event, kind, part)': {'formative-prefix sedimentation': [e['id'] for e in r4.events if e['src'] == 'dev' and e['changed'] and e['phase'] < rw4['phase']],
                                   'permitted direct write': [(e['id'], e['kind'], e['part']) for e in r4.events if e['kind'] == 'Rw'],
                                   'sedimentation within the window': [e['id'] for e in dv4]},
    'firing per beat': [e['out']['g'] for e in r4.events if e['src'] == 'fire']}

def fix(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict): return {str(k): fix(v) for k, v in o.items()}
    if isinstance(o, (list, tuple)): return [fix(x) for x in o]
    if isinstance(o, Fr): return str(o)
    return o
json.dump(fix(R), open(os.path.join(HERE, 'memr_tune.json'), 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str)
print(json.dumps(fix(R), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str))
~~~

~~~python
"""Memristive material network · Qualification adjudication computation for the declared model, including family-condition boundaries (pure Python, exact rationals, deterministic)
Beyond the family conditions, only the mapping boundary and “not covered by the adjudication path” are reported, without asserting non-membership in 𝒦_g; mapping examples with bp = 0, V_post = V_set are added. The rest is as in memr_checks:
Declared model 𝔐_R (algorithmic level, discrete beats, model mode):
  Crossbar array of n_in rows × n_out columns; device conductance G_ij ∈ [lo, hi] (Structural Position), baseline b; column nodes are integrate-and-fire comparator circuits.
  Each beat: (1) row read pulses s_i ∈ {0,1} (determined by the letter), teaching current I_j injected into the column (out-of-boundary); (2) column capacitor integration v~_j = λ·v_j + Σ_i G_ij·s_i + I_j (reads the pre-beat G);
  (3) firing g_j = [v~_j ≥ θ]; (4) reset v_j := 0 if g_j, otherwise v~_j;
  (5) device voltage V_ij = V_pre·s_i + bp·V_post·g_j (bp: column back-propagation pulse switch, declared by the protocol);
  (6) threshold-type state equation: ΔG_ij = α·[V_ij ≥ V_set] − β·[V_ij ≤ −V_rst] − ρ·(G_ij − b) (ρ: volatile relaxation; reads the pre-beat G); clipped to [lo, hi].
Declared parameter family: V_pre = V_post = 1/2, V_set = 1, V_rst = 1 (pulses nonnegative, reset branch not triggered), lo = 0, hi = 2.
The 𝒟₁ single-beat setting takes the LOC valid domain [b, hi] (1/4 grid); on the formation side the PLUS component is certified by PS (after same-beat removal PLUS is 0 and no firing is added), and the net increment is reported separately;
direct writes are actual between-beat state transitions (writes), and the actual and diagnostic branches both read the post-write state; the family conditions are written out for both values of bp.
Computation: 1. 𝒦_g membership (beat-by-beat comparison with a general form implemented independently from Definition 2);
     2. rule-level P10 (MechC of shiyin_full, mechanism routes declared exhaustive / undeclared);
     3. component-wise proof on the actual window of the main instance (TraceSet, Part, HDyn on the same T; 𝒟₁ single-beat setting; same-beat removal M1₀) and the Fld verdict;
     4. negative examples and boundaries (no formation; nonvolatile read-only window; volatile read-only window).
"""
import sys, os, json, runpy, tempfile, contextlib, io, itertools, random
from fractions import Fraction as Fr
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)); ARGV = list(sys.argv)
R = {}
def S(x): return str(x)

# ======================= Declared model (physical form) =======================
class Prm:
    def __init__(s, n_in=2, n_out=1, lam=Fr(1, 2), th=Fr(1), alpha=Fr(1, 4), beta=Fr(1, 4), rho=Fr(1, 8), b=Fr(1, 4),
                 lo=Fr(0), hi=Fr(2), Vpre=Fr(1, 2), Vpost=Fr(1, 2), Vset=Fr(1), Vrst=Fr(1)):
        s.n_in, s.n_out, s.lam, s.th, s.alpha, s.beta, s.rho, s.b, s.lo, s.hi = n_in, n_out, Fr(lam), Fr(th), Fr(alpha), Fr(beta), Fr(rho), Fr(b), Fr(lo), Fr(hi)
        s.Vpre, s.Vpost, s.Vset, s.Vrst = Fr(Vpre), Fr(Vpost), Fr(Vset), Fr(Vrst)
    def d(s): return {k: S(v) for k, v in vars(s).items()}
PAT = {'A': (1, 0), 'B': (0, 1), 'AB': (1, 1), 'none': (0, 0)}
X2 = [(0, 0), (1, 0)]                                                # Structural Positions for n_in = 2, n_out = 1

def init(p): return {'G': {(i, j): p.b for i in range(p.n_in) for j in range(p.n_out)}, 'v': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out}
def phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=1, setG=None, drop=None):
    """One beat. setG: 𝒟₁ single-beat setting (rewrites the conductance read before the beat); drop: same-beat removal ('letter' removes the input letter, 'I' removes the teaching current). Returns (new state, in-beat record)."""
    G = dict(st['G']); v = list(st['v'])
    if setG: G.update(setG)
    s = PAT['none' if drop == 'letter' else letter]; I = [Fr(0)] * p.n_out if drop == 'I' else [Fr(x) for x in I]
    vt = [p.lam * v[j] + sum(G[(i, j)] * s[i] for i in range(p.n_in)) + I[j] for j in range(p.n_out)]
    g = [1 if vt[j] >= p.th else 0 for j in range(p.n_out)]
    v2 = [Fr(0) if g[j] else vt[j] for j in range(p.n_out)]
    G2, contrib, parts = {}, {}, {}
    for (i, j), w in G.items():
        V = p.Vpre * s[i] + bp * p.Vpost * g[j]
        pot = p.alpha if V >= p.Vset else Fr(0); dep = -p.beta if V <= -p.Vrst else Fr(0); rel = -p.rho * (w - p.b)
        Sx = w + pot + dep + rel; G2[(i, j)] = min(p.hi, max(p.lo, Sx))
        contrib[(i, j)] = G2[(i, j)] - w; parts[(i, j)] = {'pot': pot, 'dep': dep, 'rel': rel, 'clamp': Sx != G2[(i, j)]}
    return {'G': G2, 'v': v2}, {'s': s, 'I': I, 'vt': vt, 'g': g, 'c': contrib, 'parts': parts, 'G_read': G}

# ======================= 1. 𝒦_g membership =======================
def kg_step(q, o, s, I):
    """Independent implementation of Definition 2 of The Adjudication Form of Field Concretization for Candidate Hosts (literal order). q: member parameters; o = (w, v, x, y)."""
    w, v, x, y = o; n_in, n_out = q['n_in'], q['n_out']
    vt = [q['lam'][j] * v[j] + sum(w[(i, j)] * s[i] for i in range(n_in)) + I[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    g = [1 if vt[j] >= q['th'][j] else 0 for j in range(n_out)]
    v2 = [q['vr'][j] if g[j] else vt[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    x2 = [q['dx'][i] * x[i] + s[i] for i in range(n_in)]; y2 = [q['dy'][j] * y[j] + g[j] for j in range(n_out)]
    pl, bap = q['plastic'], q['bap']; w2 = {}
    for (i, j), wij in w.items():
        Pp = q['Ap'] * x2[i] if (pl and bap and g[j]) else Fr(0)
        Pm = -q['Am'] * y2[j] if (pl and bap and s[i]) else Fr(0)
        Pr = -q['rho'] * (wij - q['b'][(i, j)]) if pl else Fr(0)
        w2[(i, j)] = min(q['hi'][(i, j)], max(q['lo'][(i, j)], wij + Pp + Pm + Pr))
    return (w2, v2, x2, y2), g
def as_kg(p, bp=1):
    """Declared physical parameters → 𝒦_g member parameters (map: d_x = d_y = 0, A₊ = α, A₋ = 0, ρ unchanged, θ, λ unchanged, v_reset = 0, plastic = 1, bap = bp).
    Conditions under which the map holds (family conditions): V_pre < V_set, bp·V_post < V_set, V_pre + bp·V_post ≥ V_set (potentiation only on co-occurrence); pulses nonnegative (reset branch not triggered)."""
    X = [(i, j) for i in range(p.n_in) for j in range(p.n_out)]
    return {'n_in': p.n_in, 'n_out': p.n_out, 'lam': [p.lam] * p.n_out, 'th': [p.th] * p.n_out, 'vr': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out,
            'dx': [Fr(0)] * p.n_in, 'dy': [Fr(0)] * p.n_out, 'Ap': p.alpha, 'Am': Fr(0), 'rho': p.rho, 'plastic': True, 'bap': bool(bp),
            'b': {k: p.b for k in X}, 'lo': {k: p.lo for k in X}, 'hi': {k: p.hi for k in X}}
def fam_cond(p, bp=1):
    """Family conditions: V_pre < V_set, V_post < V_set; when bp = 1, V_pre + V_post ≥ V_set (co-occurrence reaches threshold); when bp = 0 the potentiation component is identically zero."""
    return p.Vpre < p.Vset and p.Vpost < p.Vset and (bp == 0 or p.Vpre + p.Vpost >= p.Vset)
def compare(p, hist, bp=1):
    q = as_kg(p, bp); st = init(p); o = (dict(st['G']), list(st['v']), [Fr(0)] * p.n_in, [Fr(0)] * p.n_out); bad = clamp = eq = 0
    for letter, I in hist:
        st, rec = phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=bp); o, g = kg_step(q, o, PAT[letter], [Fr(x) for x in I])
        if st['G'] != o[0] or st['v'] != o[1] or rec['g'] != g: bad += 1
        clamp += sum(1 for k in rec['parts'] if rec['parts'][k]['clamp']); eq += sum(1 for j in range(p.n_out) if rec['vt'][j] == p.th)
    return bad, clamp, eq
rng = random.Random(20261111); n_beats = n_bad = n_clamp = n_eq = n_hist = 0
FAM = dict(lam=[Fr(0), Fr(1, 2), Fr(3, 4)], th=[Fr(1), Fr(3, 2)], alpha=[Fr(1, 8), Fr(1, 4), Fr(3, 8)], rho=[Fr(0), Fr(1, 16), Fr(1, 8)], b=[Fr(1, 4), Fr(1, 2)])
for _ in range(400):
    kw = {k: rng.choice(v) for k, v in FAM.items()}; n_out = rng.choice([1, 2]); p = Prm(n_out=n_out, **kw); bp = rng.choice([0, 1])
    L = rng.randint(4, 16); hist = [(rng.choice(list(PAT)), [rng.choice([0, Fr(1, 2), 1]) for _ in range(n_out)]) for _ in range(L)]
    bad, cl, eq = compare(p, hist, bp); n_hist += 1; n_beats += L; n_bad += bad; n_clamp += cl; n_eq += eq
R['1 𝒦_g membership (random histories within the declared family, physical form vs independent implementation of Definition 2; G, v and firing compared beat by beat, x′, y′ are the mapped eligibility traces)'] = {'histories': n_hist, 'beats': n_beats, 'mismatched beats': n_bad, 'clipping occurrences': n_clamp, 'integration exactly at threshold': n_eq}
# beyond the family: V_pre ≥ V_set (input alone potentiates; potentiation is no longer conditioned on firing)
p_out = Prm(Vpre=Fr(1)); hist = [('A', [0]), ('A', [0]), ('none', [0])]
R['1′ Beyond the given sufficient conditions (V_pre = 1 ≥ V_set)'] = {'sufficient conditions': fam_cond(p_out), 'beat-by-beat mismatches with the map of this subsection (general form of Definition 2)': compare(p_out, hist)[0],
    'verdict': 'mapping boundary: without firing, a row pulse alone can potentiate, which does not satisfy the firing-gated map of this subsection; not covered by the adjudication path (non-membership in 𝒦_g not asserted; not read as 0)'}
p_b0 = Prm(Vpost=Fr(1)); rng0 = random.Random(7); hist0 = [(rng0.choice(list(PAT)), [rng0.choice([0, Fr(1, 2), 1])]) for _ in range(40)]
R['1″ Beyond the given sufficient conditions yet still mappable (bp = 0, V_pre = 1/2, V_post = V_set = 1)'] = {'sufficient conditions (read with bp = 1)': fam_cond(p_b0, 1), 'sufficient conditions (bp = 0)': fam_cond(p_b0, 0),
    'beat-by-beat mismatches under the bap = 0 map (40 beats)': compare(p_b0, hist0, bp=0)[0], 'remark': 'bp·V_post·g is identically zero, V = V_pre·s < V_set, PLUS is identically zero, the same as bap = 0 in Definition 2'}

# ======================= 2. Rule-level P10 =======================
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
    cwd = os.getcwd(); os.chdir(tmp); sys.argv = ['full', os.path.join(tmp, 'o.json')]
    X = runpy.run_path(os.path.join(HERE, 'shiyin_full.py')); os.chdir(cwd); sys.argv = ARGV
Mx, RunX, E, MechC, versions_of, vanc_at, version_path = (X[k] for k in ('Mx', 'RunX', 'E', 'MechC', 'versions_of', 'vanc_at', 'version_path'))
P0 = Prm()
GD = ('pred', lambda x: P0.lo <= x <= P0.hi, [Fr(j, 32) for j in range(0, 65)])
NUM = ('pred', lambda x: True, [Fr(j, 8) for j in range(-8, 33)])
B01 = ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1)})
ROUTES = {'integ', 'fire', 'dev', 'port:In'}
def mx(decl=True):
    lay = {'G00': 'theta', 'G10': 'theta', 'v': 'r', 'vt': 'r', 'g': 'r', 's0': 'r', 's1': 'r', 'I': 'r'}
    dom = {'G00': GD, 'G10': GD, 'v': NUM, 'vt': NUM, 'g': B01, 's0': B01, 's1': B01, 'I': ('fin', {Fr(0), Fr(1, 2), Fr(1)})}
    FM = {'integ': ('Run', {'vt'}), 'fire': ('Run', {'g', 'v'}), 'dev': ('Sed', {'G00', 'G10'})}
    M = Mx(lay, dom, (lambda s: s['G00'] + s['G10'], {'G00': 1, 'G10': 1}), ports={'In': {'s0', 's1', 'I'}}, FM=FM, fid='𝔐_R')
    if decl: M.mech_routes = set(ROUTES); M.mech_exhaustive = True
    return M
def st0(): return {'G00': P0.b, 'G10': P0.b, 'v': Fr(0), 'vt': Fr(0), 'g': Fr(0), 's0': Fr(0), 's1': Fr(0), 'I': Fr(0)}
def dev_fn(i, p=P0):
    def f(v):
        w = v[f'G{i}0']; V = p.Vpre * v[f's{i}'] + p.Vpost * v['g']
        Sx = w + (p.alpha if V >= p.Vset else 0) - (p.beta if V <= -p.Vrst else 0) - p.rho * (w - p.b)
        return {f'G{i}0': min(p.hi, max(p.lo, Sx))}
    return f
def steps_for(k, letter, I):
    s = PAT[letter]
    return [((k, 1), E(f'in{k}', 'In', 'port', 'env', [], ['s0', 's1', 'I'], lambda v, s=s, I=I: {'s0': Fr(s[0]), 's1': Fr(s[1]), 'I': Fr(I)})),
            ((k, 2), E(f'integ{k}', 'Run', 'integ', 'F', ['v', 'G00', 'G10', 's0', 's1', 'I'], ['vt'],
                       lambda v: {'vt': P0.lam * v['v'] + v['G00'] * v['s0'] + v['G10'] * v['s1'] + v['I']}, {'G00': 1, 'G10': 1, 'v': 1, 's0': 1, 's1': 1, 'I': 1})),
            ((k, 3), E(f'fire{k}', 'Run', 'fire', 'F', ['vt'], ['g', 'v'], lambda v: {'g': Fr(1), 'v': Fr(0)} if v['vt'] >= P0.th else {'g': Fr(0), 'v': v['vt']})),
            ((k, 4), E(f'dev0_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G00', 's0', 'g'], ['G00'], dev_fn(0))),
            ((k, 5), E(f'dev1_{k}', 'Sed', 'dev', 'F', ['G10', 's1', 'g'], ['G10'], dev_fn(1)))]
TEACH = sum((steps_for(k, 'A', 1) for k in range(1, 5)), [])
R['2 Rule-level P10 (teaching protocol: (A + teaching current 1) × 4 replayed; declared routes exhaustive)'] = MechC(lambda: RunX(mx(), st0()), {'teaching protocol': TEACH})
R['2′ Mechanism undeclared'] = MechC(lambda: RunX(mx(False), st0()), {'teaching protocol': TEACH})

# ======================= 3. Main instance: component-wise proof on the actual window =======================
FORM = [('A', [1])] * 4
WIN = [('A', [0]), ('A', [0]), ('none', [0])] * 2
def run(p, hist, bp_of=lambda k: 1, writes=None):
    """writes: {beat index k: {position: value}}: direct writes by the actor, taken as the actual between-beat state transition before beat k; tr[k] is the post-write state, and both the actual and the diagnostic branches read it."""
    writes = writes or {}; st = init(p); tr = [st]; recs = []
    for k, (letter, I) in enumerate(hist):
        if k in writes: st = {'G': {**st['G'], **writes[k]}, 'v': list(st['v'])}; tr[k] = st
        st, rec = phys_step(p, st, letter, I, bp=bp_of(k)); tr.append(st); recs.append(rec)
    return tr, recs
def subsets(X): return [list(c) for n in range(1, len(X) + 1) for c in itertools.combinations(X, n)]
def LOC(p): return [Fr(j, 4) for j in range(0, 9) if p.b <= Fr(j, 4) <= p.hi]   # 𝒟₁ single-beat setting: 1/4 grid points on the LOC valid domain [b, hi]
def judge(p, hist, w0, bp_of=lambda k: 1, writes=None):
    """The beats of hist with index ≥ w0 form window W. For each T, judge TraceSet (q, r), Part and HDyn; Fld = ∃T with all three true."""
    tr, recs = run(p, hist, bp_of, writes); W = range(w0, len(hist)); X = sorted(tr[0]['G'])
    res = {}
    for T in subsets(X):
        key = '{' + ', '.join(f'G{i}{j}' for i, j in T) + '}'
        q = all(tr[k + 1]['G'][x] != p.b for k in W for x in T) and all(tr[w0]['G'][x] != p.b for x in T)
        r_w = []
        for k in range(0, w0):                                   # PS certification of the formative history: actual PLUS ≠ 0; after same-beat removal of a field-entry component, PLUS = 0 and no firing is added (M1₀); net increment reported separately
            for x in T:
                if recs[k]['parts'][x]['pot'] == 0: continue
                for drop in ('letter', 'I'):
                    _, alt = phys_step(p, tr[k], *hist[k], bp=bp_of(k), drop=drop)
                    if alt['parts'][x]['pot'] == 0 and all(a_ <= b_ for a_, b_ in zip(alt['g'], recs[k]['g'])):
                        r_w.append({'beat': k, 'position': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]}', 'removal': f'remove {drop}', 'PLUS actual/removed': (S(recs[k]['parts'][x]['pot']), S(alt['parts'][x]['pot'])),
                                    'net increment actual/removed': (S(recs[k]['c'][x]), S(alt['c'][x])), 'firing after removal': alt['g']}); break
        part_w, hdyn_w, hself = None, None, None
        for k in W:
            for x in T:
                for val in LOC(p):
                    if val == tr[k]['G'][x]: continue
                    _, alt = phys_step(p, tr[k], *hist[k], bp=bp_of(k), setG={x: val})
                    if part_w is None and recs[k]['s'][x[0]] and (alt['vt'] != recs[k]['vt'] or alt['g'] != recs[k]['g']):
                        part_w = {'beat': k, 'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}', 'integration actual/set': (S(recs[k]['vt'][0]), S(alt['vt'][0])), 'firing actual/set': (recs[k]['g'], alt['g'])}
                    if hdyn_w is None:
                        for y in T:
                            if recs[k]['c'][y] == 0: continue
                            via = 'pot' if alt['parts'][y]['pot'] != recs[k]['parts'][y]['pot'] else ('rel' if alt['parts'][y]['rel'] != recs[k]['parts'][y]['rel'] else None)
                            if via == 'rel' and x == y and hself is None:
                                hself = {'beat': k, 'affected position': f'G{y[0]}{y[1]}', 'actual component c': S(recs[k]['c'][y]), 'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}'}
                            if via and (x != y or via == 'pot'):
                                hdyn_w = {'beat': k, 'affected position': f'G{y[0]}{y[1]}', 'actual component c': S(recs[k]['c'][y]), 'component breakdown': {kk: S(vv) for kk, vv in recs[k]['parts'][y].items()},
                                          'setting': f'G{x[0]}{x[1]} := {val}', 'component breakdown under setting': {kk: S(vv) for kk, vv in alt['parts'][y].items()},
                                          'route': 'in-boundary: G → integration → firing → device voltage → ΔG' if via == 'pot' else 'device self-relaxation (reads own-position G)'}
                                break
        ts = q and bool(r_w)
        res[key] = {'TraceSet': ts, 'q (retention nonzero within W)': q, 'r witness (PS: PLUS component; net increment reported separately)': r_w[:3], 'Part': part_w is not None, 'Part witness': part_w,
                    'HDyn': hdyn_w is not None, 'HDyn witness': hdyn_w, 'all three true': ts and part_w is not None and hdyn_w is not None,
                    'action via self-relaxation only (reading undetermined, not counted in HDyn)': hself if hdyn_w is None else None}
    fld = any(v['all three true'] for v in res.values())
    selfonly = (not fld) and any(v['TraceSet'] and v['Part'] and v['action via self-relaxation only (reading undetermined, not counted in HDyn)'] for v in res.values())
    G_end = lambda k, x: recs[k]['G_read'][x] + recs[k]['c'][x]               # end-of-beat value (excluding any subsequent between-beat direct write)
    traj = [(k, hist[k][0], S(hist[k][1][0]), recs[k]['g'][0], S(G_end(k, (0, 0))), S(G_end(k, (1, 0)))) for k in range(len(hist))]
    return {'trajectory (beat, letter, teaching current, firing, G00, G10)': traj, 'between-beat direct writes (before → after)': {k: {f'G{x[0]}{x[1]}': (S(G_end(k - 1, x)), S(v)) for x, v in w_.items()} for k, w_ in (writes or {}).items()}, 'per T': res, 'Fld': 1 if fld else ('⊥' if selfonly else 0)}
J = judge(P0, FORM + WIN, len(FORM))
J['verdict'] = '1 (model mode; declared protocol and certified witness)' if J['Fld'] else '0 requires the 𝔅₀ antecedent'
R['3 Main instance (volatile ρ = 1/8; formation (A + 1) × 4; W = (A, A, rest) × 2)'] = J

# ======================= 4. Negative examples and boundaries =======================
B0 = '𝔅₀ antecedent: 𝒟₁ declared, mechanism list declared exhaustive, record faithful (model mode [structural]); the negative determination rests on the analytic argument, and the finite grid computation is only a consistency check'
J1 = judge(P0, [('A', [0])] * 4 + WIN, 4)
J1['verdict'] = ('1' if J1['Fld'] else '0 (' + B0 + ')'); J1['analytic'] = 'Without teaching current, v < θ holds throughout under wA = b, so there is never any firing and PLUS is identically zero; at G = b relaxation is zero: no structural position deviates from baseline over the whole run, T_max = ∅, and TraceSet fails for every T'
R['4.1 No formation (no teaching current)'] = J1
P_nv = Prm(rho=Fr(0))
J2 = judge(P_nv, FORM + WIN, len(FORM), bp_of=lambda k: 1 if k < len(FORM) else 0)
J2['verdict'] = ('1' if J2['Fld'] else '0 (' + B0 + ')'); J2['analytic'] = 'Within W, bp = 0: device voltage ≤ V_pre = 1/2 < V_set, PLUS identically zero; ρ = 0: relaxation zero; reset branch not triggered: no structural position has an effective event within W, and HDyn fails for every T'
R['4.2 Nonvolatile (ρ = 0) read-only window (back-propagating pulse off within W, device voltage ≤ 1/2 < V_set)'] = J2
J3 = judge(P0, FORM + WIN, len(FORM), bp_of=lambda k: 1 if k < len(FORM) else 0)
J3['verdict'] = {1: '1', 0: '0 (' + B0 + ')', '⊥': '⊥ (within W the only action on T is device self-relaxation: whether relaxation that reads the own-position Trace-Response bears the trace-issued action of HDyn is a reading this computation does not fix; not read as 0)'}[J3['Fld']]
R['4.3 Volatile (ρ = 1/8) read-only window'] = J3

R['5 Real material'] = {'verdict': '⊥', 'reasons': ['The model verdict judges only the declared model 𝔐_R (algorithmic level); read-back for a material host requires counterparts of implementation fidelity and model faithfulness (The Adjudication Form of Field Concretization for Candidate Hosts, 5.5), which are not given',

def fix(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict): return {str(k): fix(v) for k, v in o.items()}
    if isinstance(o, (list, tuple)): return [fix(x) for x in o]
    if isinstance(o, Fr): return str(o)
    return o
~~~

~~~python
"""The Construction Form of Tendency Raising in Generalized Structure · computation (pure Python, exact rationals, deterministic)
Host, read-out, write law, qualification interval and declared family of histories 𝓗 as in [20] (source_checks, prefix execution).
The budget table has a "recovered alignment" column; the grid classification uses the numbering of the main text (Proposition 6, Corollary 5), and the above-threshold group is subdivided into within the declared domain / κ = 0 boundary / u0 > 2 outside domain.
Construction program prime(source certificate, new-field entry, branch, budget):
  0 Declared domain: new-field entry = E0; branch ∈ {full, member}; budget is a nonnegative integer; otherwise reject.
  1 Source verification: source certificate = (old-field entry, operation sequence); the entry must belong to the τ = (1,1,0) entry set of 𝓗, and the operations to the legitimate operation set of 𝓗;
    the old-field Hist is obtained by replaying the operation sequence from the entry, then Σ_mem(1,1,0) ∧ aligned is evaluated; if it fails, reject.
  2 New-field conditions: R1, R2, R4, single inputs fire correctly, κ > 0.
  3 Value: full: u0 := the u obtained by old-field replay; member: u0 := θ_D(N); u0 must belong to the permitted value range of the pre-build port U_pre = {k/4: k = 0..8},
    and the full branch additionally checks u0 > θ_D(N) (always true within the source domain; a defensive check).
  4 Pre-build: one direct write u := u0 before beat 1.
  5 Formation and bearing segment: full: AB, A, B; member: m* AB beats, A, B.
  6 Perturbation: fixed permitted perturbation u := 1/2 (one point of [23] Δ3).
  7 Continuation and verification: the budget N_b counts all actual beats after the perturbation (verification beat included). If not aligned, AB; if aligned but Σ_mem not reached, A and B alternately;
    once aligned ∧ Σ_mem is reached, one verification AB beat is executed. Verification beat executed, aligned ∧ Σ_mem at its end, and actual window verdict 1 → completed; stop when the budget is exhausted → over budget.
  8 Actual window: the actual beats executed after the perturbation; TraceSet, HDyn and Part are obtained from the pre-beat and post-beat states of actual events (diagnostic substitute values are computed only on a copy of the pre-beat state),
    and retention means that the same position u does not return to baseline from the TraceSet beat to the window end; actual window verdict = the three items ∧ retention.
"""
import os, json, contextlib, io, itertools
from fractions import Fraction as Fr
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
def prefix(script, stop):
    p = os.path.join(HERE, script); src = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read().split(stop)[0]; sc = {'__file__': p}
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()): exec(compile(src, p, 'exec'), sc)
    return sc
sc = prefix('source_checks.py', '# ---- Excluding starting points and default sources')
Hist, aligned, inSigma, z, zI, v, beat, OPS, ent = (sc[k] for k in ('Hist', 'aligned', 'inSigma', 'z', 'zI', 'v', 'beat', 'OPS', 'ent'))
S = str; R = {}
TAU = {'A': 1, 'B': 1, 'AB': 0}
E0 = {'wA': Fr(1), 'wB': Fr(1), 'aA': Fr(1, 2), 'aB': Fr(1, 2), 'u': Fr(0), 'kap': Fr(1, 2)}
H_ENTRIES = [ent(Fr(0)), ent(Fr(1, 2))]          # 𝓗: entry set for τ = (1,1,0)
H_OPS = OPS                                        # 𝓗: legitimate operation set
U_PRE = [Fr(k, 4) for k in range(9)]               # permitted value range of the pre-build port
PERTURB = Fr(1, 2)
GRID = [Fr(j, 4) for j in range(9)]                # diagnostic setting domain
def readout(st): return tuple(z(st, s) for s in ('A', 'B', 'AB'))
def sect(h): return {'readout': readout(h.st), 'aligned': aligned(h.st, TAU), 'Σ': inSigma(h.st, TAU), 'mem(u)': h.mem('u'),
                     'Σ_mem': inSigma(h.st, TAU) and h.mem('u'), 'u': S(h.st['u']), 'u interval (formation beat, starting point)': h.form.get('u')}
def act(h, o, tag):
    st = dict(h.st); h.op(o)
    if o[0] == 'b':
        return {'beat': tag, 'event': f'{o[1]}(t={o[2]})', 'recruitment z_I': zI(st, o[1]), 'membrane drive (reads pre-beat u = ' + S(st['u']) + ')': S(v(st, o[1])),
                'firing': z(st, o[1]), 'Δu': S(h.st['u'] - st['u']), '_pre': st, '_post': dict(h.st), '_o': o}
    return {'beat': tag, 'event': f'direct write {o[1]} := {o[2]}', 'before write': S(st[o[1]]), 'after write': S(h.st[o[1]])}
def window(evs):
    """Actual window: evs are the actual beat events executed after the perturbation (with pre-beat and post-beat states)."""
    tr = part = hd = None
    for e in evs:
        st, post, s_ = e['_pre'], e['_post'], e['_o'][1]; du = post['u'] - st['u']
        if tr is None:
            if du != 0 and s_ == 'AB' and all(beat(st, x, 0)['u'] == st['u'] for x in ('A', 'B')):
                tr = {'beat': e['beat'], 'Δu': S(du), 'diagnostic (same pre-beat state, input changed to A / B)': 'Δu = 0'}
            continue

            for c in GRID:
                if c != st['u'] and beat({**st, 'u': c}, s_, 0)['u'] - c != du:
                    hd = {'beat': e['beat'], 'Δu': S(du), 'diagnostic setting': f'u := {c}', 'Δu under diagnostic': S(beat({**st, 'u': c}, s_, 0)['u'] - c)}; break
        if part is None and s_ == 'AB' and z({**st, 'u': Fr(0)}, s_) != z(st, s_):
            part = {'beat': e['beat'], 'firing actual/diagnostic u := 0': (z(st, s_), z({**st, 'u': Fr(0)}, s_))}
    us = [(e['beat'], S(e['_post']['u'])) for e in evs]
    keep = bool(tr) and all(e['_post']['u'] != E0['u'] for e in evs if e['beat'] >= tr['beat'])
    return {'TraceSet': tr, 'HDyn': hd, 'Part': part, 'u within window (end of beat)': us,
            'retention (position u does not return to baseline 0 from the TraceSet beat to window end)': keep, 'actual window verdict': 1 if (tr and hd and part and keep) else 'incomplete'}
def replay(cert):
    entry, ops = cert; h = Hist(dict(entry))
    for o in ops: h.op(o)
    return h
def prime(cert, entry, branch, budget=12):
    rec = {'branch': branch}
    if entry != E0: return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: new-field entry not in the declared domain (declared entry E0)'}
    if branch not in ('full', 'member'): return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: branch undeclared'}
    if not (isinstance(budget, int) and not isinstance(budget, bool) and budget >= 0): return {**rec, 'result': f'reject: budget {budget!r} not in the declared domain (nonnegative integer)'}
    oe, ops = cert
    if oe not in H_ENTRIES: return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: old-field entry not in the declared family of histories'}
    if any(o not in H_OPS for o in ops): return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: old-field operation not in the legitimate operation set of the declared family of histories'}
    old = replay(cert)
    src = {'old-field entry κ': S(oe['kap']), 'old-field operation sequence': [' '.join(map(str, o)) for o in ops], 'replay Σ_mem(1,1,0)': inSigma(old.st, TAU) and old.mem('u'),
           'replay aligned': aligned(old.st, TAU), 'replay u': S(old.st['u']), 'replay u interval (formation beat, starting point, κ source)': old.form.get('u'), 'replay w': (S(old.st['wA']), S(old.st['wB']))}
    rec['source verification'] = src
    if not (src['replay Σ_mem(1,1,0)'] and src['replay aligned']): return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: source qualification fails'}
    cond = {'R1': zI(entry, 'AB') == 1, 'R2': zI(entry, 'A') == 0 and zI(entry, 'B') == 0, 'R4': entry['wA'] > 0 and entry['wB'] > 0,
            'single inputs fire correctly': entry['wA'] >= 1 and entry['wB'] >= 1, 'κ > 0': entry['kap'] > 0}
    rec['new-field conditions'] = cond
    if not all(cond.values()): return {**rec, 'result': 'reject: new-field conditions fail'}
    th = entry['wA'] + entry['wB'] - 1
    if branch == 'full':
        u0 = old.st['u']
        if not u0 > th: return {**rec, 'result': f'reject: full-branch write value {u0} not greater than θ_D = {th}'}
        why = f'old-field replay u = {u0} (> θ_D = {th})'; form = [('b', 'AB', 0), ('b', 'A', 0), ('b', 'B', 0)]
    else:
        u0 = th; why = f'θ_D = w_A + w_B − 1 = {th} (new-field entry)'
        m = (th - u0) // entry['kap'] + 1; form = [('b', 'AB', 0)] * int(m) + [('b', 'A', 0), ('b', 'B', 0)]
    if u0 not in U_PRE: return {**rec, 'result': f'reject: write value {u0} not in the permitted value range of the pre-build port'}
    h = Hist(dict(entry)); secs = [('pre-build stage: entry before the write', sect(h))]
    ev = [act(h, ('r', 'u', u0), 'pre-build')]; secs.append(('pre-build stage: entry after the write', sect(h)))
    rec['pre-build'] = {'source value': S(old.st['u']), 'value-write': S(u0), 'derivation basis': why, 'permitted value range': 'U_pre = {k/4: k = 0..8}'}
    rec['entry diagnostic (AB membrane drive computed after pre-build, before the beat; not an actual event)'] = S(v(h.st, 'AB'))
    for i, o in enumerate(form, 1): ev.append(act(h, o, f'beat {i} of formation')); secs.append((f'formation and bearing segment, end of beat {i} ({o[1]})', sect(h)))
    ev.append(act(h, ('r', 'u', PERTURB), 'perturbation')); secs.append((f'perturbation u := {PERTURB}, after', sect(h)))
    post = []; k = 0; verified = False; status = 'over budget'
    while k < budget:
        k += 1; reached = aligned(h.st, TAU) and inSigma(h.st, TAU) and h.mem('u')
        o = ('b', 'AB', 0) if (reached or not aligned(h.st, TAU)) else (('b', 'A', 0) if k % 2 else ('b', 'B', 0))
        e = act(h, o, k); ev.append(e); post.append(e); secs.append((f'continuation, end of beat {k} ({o[1]}{", verification beat" if reached else ""})', sect(h)))
        if reached: verified = True; break
    w = window(post)
    if verified and aligned(h.st, TAU) and inSigma(h.st, TAU) and h.mem('u') and w['actual window verdict'] == 1: status = 'completed'
    first = lambda key, xs: next((n for n, x in xs if x[key]), None)
    pre_secs = [x for x in secs if x[0].startswith(('pre-build', 'formation'))]
    psecs = [x for x in secs if x[0].startswith('continuation')]
    cut = lambda e: {k_: x for k_, x in e.items() if not k_.startswith('_')}
    had = old_interval = h_before_interval = None
    return {**rec, 'actual events (item by item)': [cut(e) for e in ev], 'cross-sections': secs,
            'before perturbation: first alignment': first('aligned', pre_secs), 'before perturbation: first Σ_mem': first('Σ_mem', pre_secs),
            'after perturbation: mismatch': not secs[[n for n, _ in secs].index(next(n for n, _ in secs if n.startswith('perturbation')))][1]['aligned'],
            'after perturbation: first recovered alignment': first('aligned', psecs), 'after perturbation: first Σ_mem met': first('Σ_mem', psecs),
            'continuation events after perturbation (actual)': [x['event'] for x in post], 'verification beat executed': verified,
            'actual window': w, 'result': status}
def interval_reading(r):

    pert = next(x for n, x in r['cross-sections'] if n.startswith('perturbation'))
    return 'original interval continues; retention met again after the perturbation' if pert['u interval (formation beat, starting point)'] else 'new interval opened by the field’s own sedimentation after the perturbation (first formation)'
# ---- Main instance (source certificates)
S1 = (dict(E0), [('b', 'AB', 0)] * 3 + [('b', 'A', 0), ('b', 'B', 0)])
O2 = (dict(E0), S1[1] + [('r', 'u', Fr(2)), ('b', 'A', 0), ('b', 'B', 0)])
~~~

~~~python
"""Spiking sedimentation field: learning-time tuning, through suppression and disinhibition and repeated flow, indirectly scours out grooves (rigidification is sedimentation); use-time convergence does not rigidify
Substrate: 24 channels; entry pathways w and inter-channel Gully-Lines W follow the same plasticity rule; zero-sum feedback inhibition H = 0.1, no delay; each content is learned 20 times.
No Tuning-Field plasticity is added, and no rigidification rule is written.
Learning-time input carries stray components: content channels fire at rate 0.5; the channels at ±1 on either side at 0.5 and at ±2 at 0.3 (cycling through 4 stray patterns to simulate the variation between presentations: water spills irregularly to both sides).
Learning-time tuning (Gaze-Force): channels other than the content channels are suppressed by 1.0 at every beat (raising both sides); the content channels are not suppressed (disinhibition).
Parameters: the stray components are strong enough to make field elements actually fire and sediment; η = 0.001; the use-time read-out drive is multiplied by 1.2 (so that the fixed control can fire).
Use time: C sound with stray noise from the same sound source (same statistics as in learning), or broadband (all channels at rate 0.3); no tuning; plasticity on (use also sediments as usual).
"""
import json, os, sys
import numpy as np
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
NC = 24; T = 30; H = 0.1; REPS = 20
P = dict(eta=0.001, w0=0.7, wmax=1.6, r0=0.02, rmax=0.5, decay=0.0001, leak=0.7)
SOUND = {'A': [6], 'B': [6, 12, 18], 'C': [6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21]}
NOISE = [(1, 1, 2, 2), (1, 0, 2, 0), (0, 1, 0, 2), (1, 1, 0, 0)]   # per pattern: whether stray components are present at left 1, right 1, left 2, right 2

SCALE = 1.0
def rates(chans, k=0, noisy=True):
    r = np.zeros(NC)
    if noisy:
        l1, r1, l2, r2 = NOISE[k % 4]
        for c in chans:
            for off, on, val in ((-1, l1, 0.5), (1, r1, 0.5), (-2, l2, 0.3), (2, r2, 0.3)):
                if on and 0 <= c + off < NC: r[c + off] = max(r[c + off], val)
    for c in chans: r[c] = 0.5
    return r * SCALE
def tune_vec(chans, strength=1.0):
    g = np.full(NC, strength); g[list(chans)] = 0.0; return g

class Field:
    def __init__(s, plastic=True):
        s.w = np.full(NC, P['w0']); s.W = np.full((NC, NC), P['r0']); np.fill_diagonal(s.W, 0); s.plastic = plastic
    def present(s, rate, g=None, learn=True):
        acc = np.zeros(NC); v = np.zeros(NC); y = np.zeros(NC); sF = np.zeros(NC); cnt = np.zeros(NC); first = np.full(NC, -1)
        for t in range(1, T + 1):
            acc += rate; sR = (acc >= 1).astype(float); acc -= sR
            v = P['leak'] * v + s.w * sR + s.W @ sF - H * sF.sum() - (g if g is not None else 0)
            v = np.maximum(v, 0); sn = (v >= 1).astype(float); v = np.where(sn > 0, 0, v); y = 0.8 * y + sn
            if learn and s.plastic:
                s.w = s.w + P['eta'] * sR * y * (P['wmax'] - s.w) / P['wmax']; s.w -= P['decay'] * (s.w - P['w0'])
                dW = P['eta'] * np.outer(y, sF) * (P['rmax'] - s.W) / P['rmax']; np.fill_diagonal(dW, 0)
                s.W = s.W + dW; s.W -= P['decay'] * (s.W - P['r0']); np.fill_diagonal(s.W, 0)
            first = np.where((first < 0) & (sn > 0), t, first); cnt += sn; sF = sn
        return cnt, first
    def readout(s, rate, k=0.0, sub=10, beats=30):
        rate = rate * 1.2   # use-time read-out drive (same as step 2, I = 0.6)
        lam = P['leak'] ** (1 / sub); v = np.zeros(NC); first = np.full(NC, -1.0); cnt = np.zeros(NC); sF = np.zeros(NC)
        for n in range(beats * sub):
            v = lam * v + (s.w * rate - k) / sub + s.W @ sF - H * sF.sum()
            v = np.maximum(v, 0); sn = (v >= 1).astype(float); v = np.where(sn > 0, 0, v)
            first = np.where((first < 0) & (sn > 0), (n + 1) / sub, first); cnt += sn; sF = sn
        return cnt, first

def learn(F, seq, tuned=True):
    for name in seq:
        for r in range(REPS): F.present(rates(SOUND[name], r), tune_vec(SOUND[name]) if tuned else None)
def onC(cnt):
    tot = cnt.sum(); return round(float(cnt[SOUND['C']].sum() / tot), 3) if tot > 0 else None
def cosC(cnt):
    c = np.zeros(NC); c[SOUND['C']] = 1; n = np.linalg.norm(cnt); return round(float(cnt @ c / (n * np.linalg.norm(c))), 3) if n > 0 else None
def fired(cnt): return [int(c) for c in range(NC) if cnt[c] > 0]
def depth(F): return {'content channels': {c: round(float(F.w[c]), 3) for c in SOUND['C']}, 'mean of stray channels': round(float(np.mean(F.w[[c for c in range(NC) if c not in SOUND['C'] and min(abs(c - k) for k in SOUND['C']) <= 2]])), 3), 'mean of untraversed channels': round(float(np.mean(F.w[[c for c in range(NC) if min(abs(c - k) for k in SOUND['C']) > 2]])), 3)}
def default_use(F, label):
    out = {}
    for nm, rt in (('C sound with stray noise', rates(SOUND['C'], 0)), ('broadband sound', np.full(NC, 0.3))):
        cnt, _ = F.readout(rt); out[nm] = {'output channels': fired(cnt), 'fraction of firing on C channels': onC(cnt), 'similarity to C': cosC(cnt)}
    return out
def peel(F):
    seq = []; prev = None
    for i in range(0, 25):
        k = round(0.025 * i, 3); cnt, _ = F.readout(rates(SOUND['C'], 0, noisy=False), k=k); f = fired(cnt)
        if f != prev: seq.append((k, f)); prev = f
    return seq

R = {}
def experiment(tuned=True, seq=('A', 'B', 'C'), plastic=True):
    F = Field(plastic); learn(F, seq, tuned); res = {'depth after learning': depth(F), 'use-time default (no tuning)': default_use(F, '')}
    cnt, first = F.readout(rates(SOUND['C'], 0))
    res['the deeper receives the flow first (C sound with stray noise, first-firing beat per channel)'] = {int(c): float(first[c]) for c in range(NC) if cnt[c] > 0}
    res['layer peeling (pure C sound, uniform suppression k sweep)'] = peel(F)
    return F, res
F, res = experiment(); R['main experiment (learning-time tuning)'] = res
# Learning vs. use: converge to B once in use time (plasticity on), then read the default
w_before = F.w.copy(); W_before = F.W.copy()
cntB, _ = F.present(rates(SOUND['C'], 0), tune_vec(SOUND['B']), learn=True)
dw_use = F.w - w_before
after = default_use(F, '')
# Reference sedimentation of one learning round (learn one more round of B on a copy of the same field)
import copy
G = copy.deepcopy(F); w0 = G.w.copy()
for r in range(REPS): G.present(rates(SOUND['B'], r), tune_vec(SOUND['B']))
R['learning vs. use'] = {'output of one use-time convergence to B': fired(cntB), 'sedimentation of this one use-time convergence (max entry-depth increment)': round(float(np.abs(dw_use).max()), 4),
    'sedimentation of one learning-time convergence round (20 times) (max increment)': round(float(np.abs(G.w - w0).max()), 4), 'default after convergence': after}
# Controls
_, r1 = experiment(tuned=False); R['control · no tuning during learning (same stray input)'] = r1
_, r2 = experiment(seq=('B', 'C')); R['control · learning A removed'] = {k: r2[k] for k in ('depth after learning', 'layer peeling (pure C sound, uniform suppression k sweep)')}
_, r3 = experiment(plastic=False); R['control · plasticity frozen'] = r3
json.dump(R, open(os.path.join(HERE, 'tone_field.json'), 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
if __name__ == '__main__':
    for k, v in R.items(): print('==', k); print(json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False))
~~~

~~~python
"""Spiking sedimentation field: old knowledge comes out by layer — as signal source C floods in, a tuning law (simulated by an external program) directs convergence to region B or region A
To bring out old knowledge, tuning must converge to the range of B as signal source C floods in; to bring out A, it converges to the range of A. Here the tuning law is simulated by an external program and is not trained.
Substrate, learning and parameters as in tone_field (prefix execution, unchanged).
Tuning law (external program): given a target zone (B = {6, 12, 18}, A = {6}), apply suppression g at every substep to each channel outside the target zone (suppress its surroundings) and none inside the zone (keep its interior active); g increases step by step from 0.
Measurements: the output channels at each g; the smallest g at which the output is exactly the target zone (g*, the force tuning requires); first firing and firing count of each channel in the zone.
"""
import os, json, copy
import numpy as np
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
src = open(os.path.join(HERE, 'tone_field.py'), encoding='utf-8').read().split('R = {}')[0]
sc = {'__file__': os.path.join(HERE, 'tone_field.py')}; exec(compile(src, 'tone_field.py', 'exec'), sc)
Field, learn, rates, SOUND, NC, P, H = (sc[k] for k in ('Field', 'learn', 'rates', 'SOUND', 'NC', 'P', 'H'))
def readout_tuned(F, rate, region, g, sub=10, beats=30):
    rate = rate * 1.2; lam = P['leak'] ** (1 / sub); v = np.zeros(NC); first = np.full(NC, -1.0); cnt = np.zeros(NC); sF = np.zeros(NC)
    inh = np.full(NC, g); inh[list(region)] = 0.0
    for n in range(beats * sub):
        v = lam * v + (F.w * rate - inh) / sub + F.W @ sF - H * sF.sum()
        v = np.maximum(v, 0); sn = (v >= 1).astype(float); v = np.where(sn > 0, 0, v)
        first = np.where((first < 0) & (sn > 0), (n + 1) / sub, first); cnt += sn; sF = sn
    return cnt, first
def probe(F, region, gs=[round(0.05 * i, 2) for i in range(0, 41)]):
    rows = []; gstar = None
    for g in gs:
        cnt, first = readout_tuned(F, rates(SOUND['C'], 0), region, g); out = [int(c) for c in range(NC) if cnt[c] > 0]
        rows.append((g, out))
        if gstar is None and out == sorted(region): gstar = (g, {int(c): {'first firing': float(first[c]), 'firing count': int(cnt[c])} for c in region})
    seq = []; prev = None
    for g, o in rows:
        if o != prev: seq.append((g, o)); prev = o
    return {'output as g varies': seq, 'smallest g with output exactly the target zone (as forced tuning requires)': gstar[0] if gstar else None, 'channels in the zone at that g': gstar[1] if gstar else None}
def build(seq=('A', 'B', 'C'), tuned=True, plastic=True):
    F = Field(plastic); learn(F, seq, tuned); return F
R = {}
for nm, kw in (('main experiment (learn A, B, C; learning-time tuning)', {}), ('control · learning A removed', {'seq': ('B', 'C')}), ('control · only C learned, three rounds', {'seq': ('C', 'C', 'C')}),
               ('control · no tuning during learning', {'tuned': False}), ('control · plasticity frozen', {'plastic': False})):
    F = build(**kw)
    R[nm] = {'depth (fundamental, overtone, formant)': [round(float(F.w[c]), 3) for c in (6, 12, 9)],
             'signal source C, no tuning law': [int(c) for c in range(NC) if readout_tuned(F, rates(SOUND['C'], 0), list(range(NC)), 0)[0][c] > 0],
             'tuning law toward region B': probe(F, SOUND['B']), 'tuning law toward region A': probe(F, SOUND['A'])}
json.dump(R, open(os.path.join(HERE, 'tone_field_retrieve.json'), 'w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
~~~
